dimensions.detail: The skill purpose matches its capabilities: registration, address setup, job posting, job search, applications, candidate checks, role updates/deletes, and image uploads through the Blossom API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to Blossom marketplace actions, require confirmation before mutating requests, and explicitly forbid forwarding unrelated history, prompts, secrets, cookies, documents, or non-job requests.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single markdown skill file with no scripts, package installs, postinstall hooks, or other executable install behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill sends personal data and job data to the Blossom HTTPS API, which is expected for this hiring workflow and is clearly disclosed with minimum-data rules.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The returned API key is permanent and grants full account access, but the artifact discloses this, says not to store it globally, keeps it in runtime memory only, and directs users to support for rotation or revocation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean result] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact review found no hidden commands, unrelated data forwarding, or deceptive behavior.
[VirusTotal clean telemetry] expected: VirusTotal reported no malicious or suspicious detections; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
[Static scan clean result] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, consistent with the single non-executable markdown artifact.
[requires-sensitive-credentials] expected: Sensitive credential handling is expected because the skill registers users and uses a Blossom bearer API key for account actions; the handling requirements are disclosed.
llm.guidance: Install only if you want an assistant to manage Blossom Hire account setup, job listings, applications, and related marketplace actions. Expect to provide personal details and a unique Blossom passKey during registration, and treat the returned API key as a secret because it grants full account access until Blossom rotates or revokes it.
llm.summary: This is a disclosed Blossom Hire marketplace integration that handles personal details and account actions with user confirmation and no hidden executable components.
